title: LaVida Massage Cartersville
gap: Duration and price for most massage and facial types not stated
blurb: Guests can enjoy full-body massages personalized to their ideal pressure or facials and advanced skincare designed specifically for their skin. Treatments include classic, hot stone, deep tissue, prenatal, and oncology massages, as well as various facials like hydrating, brightening, anti-aging, and peel facials. The spa offers introductory prices for first-time guests and monthly memberships for regular self-care.
